reason: I've already paid for a promo platform that brought nobody, and Instagram does the job for free. An app that isn't even public yet has no users, so why would I pay for it?
objection: It's a new app with no audience. I'd be paying €150 a month, with a 3-month minimum, to be shown to nobody.
would_change_my_mind: Proof of real users in my area, such as a few thousand people already using it in Friuli, or a couple of venues like mine saying it filled their nights. Or a free or pay-per-ticket deal with no minimum.
